gen-gf-quintessential-fs-bespoke-sans: Graceful and personal, Quintessential crowds its letters together like stamped metal slugs, with a hand-drawn wobble. Bespoke Sans is the sharper, more refined voice, leaving generous room between each curve end and its stem, and it is comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-quintessential-fs-literata: Hand-drawn and tightly packed, Quintessential looks like stamped metal slugs. And Literata, a text serif with sturdy hairlines and open-mouthed curves, keeps going down the page without tiring, its thick and thin strokes settling into a steady hum.
gen-gf-raleway-dots-fs-gambetta: Heavy stems, hairline filaments, curves left wide open. Gambetta is the one to carry sentences, a classic serif with wide channels into each counter, while Raleway Dots does its best work making a loud first impression and is not meant for much more.
gen-gf-raleway-dots-fs-rowan: Raleway Dots is all inky weight and filament-fine hairlines, built to command attention in a display role. But Rowan, a text serif with heavier verticals like a gently tilted nib, does the quieter work of being friendly, and it is comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-raleway-dots-lora: Raleway Dots hits hard with heavy shoulders and hairline joins on its m. Lora, a text serif with a broad, welcoming c and stems barely heavier than their connecting arms, does the gentler work, though it is not meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-rampart-one-fs-rowan: Bold lettering with shuttered lowercase and widely stretched spacing leads here, closed up tight against the open curves below. Rowan, a classic serif, stays generous.
gen-gf-ranga-fs-rowan: Dark, tightly knit, and cut from one ribbon. Ranga does its best work as a distinctive outline voice, while Rowan, a serif with moderate contrast and generous curve openings, is the friendlier one for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-ravi-prakash-fs-paquito: Expressive and bold, Ravi Prakash draws every curve as thick as a straight stem, in plain constant-width lines. Paquito, a classic serif, sits close to it in feel, confident and approachable with minimal gap between x-height and caps.
gen-gf-red-rose-fs-karma: Commanding and distinctive, Red Rose fills the middle of the line with a big x-height and an open e. And Karma, a text serif with a mild taper like wire rolled barely flat, finishes its terminals clear of the stem and keeps the eye moving smoothly.
gen-gf-red-rose-fs-paquito: Paquito is a confident, approachable serif with almost no gap between its x-height and caps, and it is not meant for long paragraphs. And Red Rose stands against it with a commanding, open-e look that fills the middle of every line.
